decision_table.name: Determine_OK_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Oklahoma state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in OK (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Oklahoma filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: Oklahoma Form 512 Instructions (Corporation Income Tax Return) Reference: 68 Okla. Stat. § 2355 et seq. (Corporate Income Tax) Reference: OAC 710:50-17-3 (What constitutes "Nexus")

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Oklahoma filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: Oklahoma Tax Commission Economic Nexus Guidance
No Oklahoma nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_OK_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Oklahoma state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Oklahoma state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations (OAC 710:50-17-51) - State income tax refunds included in federal income - IRC Section 199A deduction addback (depending on OK conformity) - State income taxes deducted on federal return
Subtractions may include: - Interest on Oklahoma state and municipal obligations (OAC 710:50-17-51) - Dividends from affiliated corporations (68 Okla. Stat. § 2357) - Income from U.S. obligations (if included in federal)
Reference: Oklahoma Form 512 Schedule B (Additions and Subtractions) Reference: OAC 710:50-17-51 (Adjustments to arrive at Oklahoma taxable income) Reference: 68 Okla. Stat. § 2355 et seq.
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_OK_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Oklahoma state corporate income tax. Applies 4% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Oklahoma state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to OK: × [Apportionment % using single-sales factor] 3. State additions: + [Additions from Schedule B] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions from Schedule B] 5. OK taxable income: = [Result] 6. OK tax rate: × 4.0% 7. OK income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. OK credits: - [Credits from Schedule C] 9. OK tax liability: = [Final tax]
Oklahoma uses 100% single-sales factor apportionment. Tax rate is a flat 4% with no brackets or alternative minimum tax.
Available OK credits include: - Investment/New Jobs Tax Credit (68 Okla. Stat. § 2357.21) - Small Employer Quality Jobs Incentive Act Credit - Historic Preservation Tax Credit - Research and Development Tax Credit - Venture Capital Tax Credit - Oklahoma Quality Events Incentive Act Credit
Reference: Oklahoma Form 512 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Instructions Reference: Oklahoma Form 512 Schedule C (Tax Credits) Reference: 68 Okla. Stat. § 2355 (4% tax rate) Reference: 68 Okla. Stat. § 2358 (Apportionment - single-sales factor) Reference: OAC 710:50-17 (Corporate Income Tax)
No Oklahoma nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Oklahoma taxable income - no tax liability. Oklahoma allows NOL carryforward (68 Okla. Stat. § 2357.6).
